build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). Backgrounds generated with scripts/kie_image_gen.mjs (Node port of kie_image_gen.py, made because this machine has no working Python interpreter) -- kie.ai gpt-image-2-text-to-image, feed background at aspect-ratio 3:4 / resolution 2K, story background at aspect-ratio 9:16 / resolution 2K. Text/logo layer is real HTML+CSS (index.html / index-story.html) reusing the layout and CSS from posts/instagram/combo-manicura-pedicura-corte/, with the services+price block replaced by a single hours row. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). The hours row (10 AM-5 PM) is set in Fira Sans Condensed, never Lost in South, because that font is missing the 0/2/8 digit glyphs.
